$comment: Tamper-evidence manifest for the committed data the MONARK site renders. Keys are repo-root-relative POSIX paths; values are the SHA-256 of each file after CRLF->LF normalization over UTF-8 bytes (the rule of fixtures/manifest.json), so the hash is OS-independent. Each listed file is checked against its entry by its own fail-closed loader before a page renders it, and the build fails on a mismatch or on a file missing from this list: fixtures/figures-sourced.json by apps/site/lib/load-committed.ts; apps/site/data/bell-legal.json (the legal spans a site gate cannot carry verbatim in page source) by apps/site/lib/bell-legal-load.ts, for /bell/terms and /bell/privacy; apps/site/data/bell-served.json (the facts of the first and of the latest signed publication of the served Bell host) by apps/site/lib/bell-served-load.ts, for /bell, /bell/method, / and /applications; apps/site/data/narabi-served.json (the committed Narabi class, the sentinel's publication schedule and the probe's deadline) and apps/site/data/narabi-capture.json (the committed capture of the two files the Narabi sentinel publishes, endpoint URL lists replaced by their count) by apps/site/lib/narabi-served-load.ts and apps/site/lib/narabi-capture-load.ts, for /narabi and the Narabi freshness line of / and /fleet; apps/site/data/ukemi-course.json (the copy of the Ukemi course report) and apps/site/data/ukemi-served.json (the served state of the liquidation class) by apps/site/lib/ukemi-course-load.ts and apps/site/lib/ukemi-served-load.ts, for /ukemi/course, / and /fleet; apps/site/data/harness-served.json and the two traces recorded over the MCP transport, fixtures/byo-demo-trace.json and fixtures/h5-e2e-trace.json (each also sha-pinned by its probe test; a re-record re-pins here too), by apps/site/lib/harness-served-load.ts, for /integrators, /console and /roadmap. apps/site/data/docs-references.json (the bibliography of the documentation section, each cited work with its reading level) by apps/site/lib/docs-references-load.ts, for the pages under /docs. apps/site/data/dojo-served.json (the facts of the latest signed snapshot of the served Dojo host, bound to the committed deploy check of the same bodies) by apps/site/lib/dojo-served-load.ts, for /dojo and its link on /token. The served-data files are written by the source repository's sync tools, which are not part of this export. Regenerate an entry after changing its file: node -e "const{readFileSync}=require('fs'),{createHash}=require('crypto');console.log(createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync('fixtures/figures-sourced.json','utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'),'utf8').digest('hex'))".
